1.2.1.6-f1.accuracy_reason: In Galenic anatomy, similar parts are the homogeneous tissues and spermatic parts are those formed from the seed (bones, nerves, membranes, vessels), as opposed to the fleshy parts made from blood.

1.2.1.6-f19.accuracy_reason: The 'debitum' is the conjugal debt of 1 Cor 7:3, which Burton signals with 'as Paul calls it'. 'Generositas' as noble stock or good breeding is right.

1.2.1.6-f40.accuracy_reason: Damianus à Goes is Damião de Góis, the Portuguese humanist who wrote on the northern peoples (e.g. the Lapps). The identification is right.

1.2.1.6-f42.accuracy_reason: Pica is the morbid craving for unfit foods, classically linked with pregnancy, and it matches the 'longing' in the main text.
